## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md): the change fits the project's vision (what does not fit may be closed without discussion), and releases are built and signed only by the project owner.
- [ ] No real data: demo vault screenshots and made-up fixtures.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --workspace` pass.
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run format:check` pass in `apps/desktop`.
- [ ] New text in `locales/` (pt-BR, en and es), if any.
- [ ] New migration numbered above the last released one, if any.
- [ ] No new dependency, or the reason for it is in the description ([docs/development.md](../docs/development.md#dependencies)).
- [ ] Commit messages in English, signed off (DCO, `git commit -s`).
